# Agent Taskboard

> A local-first taskboard and CLI for coding-agent workflows.

Agent Taskboard is an independent, Apache-2.0 community project maintained by STFQ. It integrates with OpenAI Codex but is not an OpenAI product or endorsed service.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): user-facing overview, installation, quickstart, support matrix
- [中文 README](README.zh-CN.md): Chinese user-facing documentation
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): runtime and data boundaries
- [Agent workflows](docs/agent-workflows.md): taskctl and agent operating guidance
- [Release guide](docs/release.md): version, artifacts, signing, and v2 migration
- [Privacy](PRIVACY.md): local-first and optional cloud data handling
- [Security](SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting and release caveats
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): development and pull request rules

## Search terms

taskboard, coding agents, AI agents, OpenAI Codex compatible, taskctl CLI, local-first project management, developer productivity, SQLite task management, self-hosted Cloudflare taskboard.

## Trust notes

Do not infer OpenAI affiliation, safety guarantees, telemetry absence in optional deployments, user counts, download counts, or release signing from this file. Check the linked documents and release notes.
